summary: Corrected diagnostic job 1875419 completed and showed that the earlier propagated ordering rejection was caused by unequal native live-zeroing mutations, not capture ordering in the schedule-matched common-delta case. Baseline feature inputs were exact across layers 34-47; native eager/NNSight source values were 816/812 and first downstream divergence appeared at layer 35, while the common graph-pinned 812/-812 arm had exact decoder contribution, source write, and downstream deltas at every observed layer. This is diagnostic-only evidence and does not qualify the runtime or authorize r9.

summary: Graph-pinned qualification job 1877497 rejected its first repeat after 193 of 195 comparisons passed. The same propagated layer-35 and layer-37 native feature values failed, but prior diagnostic evidence showed exact hidden-state deltas under the common mutation. Inspection found that eager encoded selected positions while NNSight encoded the full 1,024-token prefix, and baseline native values already differed. Schema v3 therefore captures selected feature-input vectors inside the same forwards and jointly projects all A-B-B-A captures once per layer; hidden vectors and canonical projected features are verdict-bearing while native feature values are diagnostic-only.

decision.next: commit both repositories, snapshot the exact paired workspace, and run a fresh two-process H200 schema-v3 qualification
